latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — TikTok Video Editor for PC.

- Edit and export TikTok-ready videos from raw clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) on desktop.
- Cloud GPU processing: 30–60 seconds for most edits, output 1080p MP4 files.
- Automatic setup: token generation, session creation, and connection feedback ("Ready!" when done).
- Supports edit commands, quick exports, batch processing, and timeline previews.
- User prompts routed by intent; common workflows and error handling built in.
